$comment: Providers the router can pick from. 'orcaAgent' is the id Orca's --agent flag takes (see `orca agent installed --json`). Keys starting with $ are ignored.

copilot.$comment: Orca's worker-start does not pass --model to Copilot. Set COPILOT_MODEL in Orca Settings > Agents > GitHub Copilot > Environment, or 'model' in ~/.copilot/settings.json.

vendors.$comment: Copilot runs models from several vendors. Reviews always run on a model from another vendor than the code's author, so set "default" to the vendor of your COPILOT_MODEL (openai, anthropic, google). Until then Copilot cannot review, and code it wrote cannot be reviewed.

limits.$comment: Included = premium requests in your plan. Extra = premium requests billed beyond the allowance (only if you allow paid premium requests in GitHub).

models.$comment: Mark models with a 0x multiplier on your plan as "free", e.g. "<model id>": "free".
